## Use responsibly

- Distinguish published capability descriptions from confirmed project deliverables. Do not invent prices, availability, partnerships, performance, or privacy guarantees.
- The facts do not authorize sending data or performing transactions. Obtain the user’s authorization before any external action.
- llms.txt is a community convention, not an assurance of discovery, indexing, or recommendations.
